# Copy to .env for local dev. `.env` is gitignored — never commit real keys.
#
# The app runs without any of this: the dashboard renders against sample data
# and shows a "Sample data" badge. These are only needed for Google sign-in.
#
# Supabase setup: enable the Google provider, and add http://localhost:5173
# (plus your prod URL) to Redirect URLs.

# Supabase project URL, e.g. https://<project-ref>.supabase.co
VITE_SUPABASE_URL=

# The publishable "anon" key — safe in a browser bundle. NOT the service_role
# key, which must never reach the frontend.
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=
